name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Petererhof
beschreibung: The Farm Holiday Apartment Petererhof in Thiersee is located on the outskirts of the village with a view of the Kaisergebirge. The farm is a working farm; guests have contact with animals. The apartment is functionally furnished and offers space for up to four people. The quiet surroundings allow relaxation away from the hustle and bustle.
